title: Envelope
description: Shape shared by every frame, in both directions. See docs/architecture/shared/05-websocket-protocol.md.

v.description: Protocol version. Adding an optional field or a new event does not change it; removing a field, renaming a type or changing a meaning does.

kind.description: What the frame is. `request` travels server to client and demands an answer — that is the case the whole protocol is designed around.

type.description: What the frame is, within its kind.

traceId.description: Correlates this frame with the server logs of the same operation.

correlationId.description: `id` of the frame that caused this one.

sessionId.description: Session the frame belongs to, when it belongs to one. It is what fan-out routes on, and what ties the many traces of a conversation together.

seq.description: Monotonic per session, on events only. This is what makes replay after a reconnect possible.
